description: Pepe gathers distinct pebble shares inside one ring without changing what each holds.

visual_review.new_mark: A charcoal enclosure holds two separate red ochre pebble clusters on bare upper-right rock.
visual_review.hands: The sole visible inherited hand has four fingers and one thumb; no new hands or stencils.
limitations: Inherited rock retains photographic texture; fine pigment detail softens in the JPEG. Visual inspection is local judgment.

image_method: Built-in imagegen transparent pigment; bounded local compositing, omitting chalk tallies. Full prompt in asset-build/README-37.md.
